nodes.text: What'd they say? What'd they say? Do we have an answer? Can I finally stop looking over my shoulder? Seeing these eyes everywhere is unsettling.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Attempted? They didn't attempt, they succeeded. And now the big players are trying to cash in on the tech. Squash the rebellion and send us back to the dark ages. You'll miss these glittering lights when they're gone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Attempted? They didn't attempt, they succeeded. And now the big players are trying to cash in on the tech. Squash the rebellion and send us back to the dark ages. You'll miss these glittering lights when they're gone.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Of course he did! He's one of them! How can you be so gullible? Believing things like that is what will get you locked in a padded room inside a clandestine CorpSec facility where they turn your brain into mush!

nodes.text: So that's it?! That's all we have left? I'm cursed to wander under surveillance capitalism wondering when the greedy overlords will come and harvest what's left of my mind before shunning me back to... WHENEVER IT WAS I WAS BORN?!

nodes.text: Intention here is if the player is more corp JD won't take it. If they're more punk, he will.

So, as I'm writing this, I'm realizing we might need two poison pill bottles. My intention was to use the same inventory item from Masato's quest in an effort not to have so many new items this late in development. However, with it having the same name in both quests, this instruction could break the quest if the player hasn't finished one or the other as it would essentially take it away for both. Marko, I'll defer to you but possibly just duplicate the item and give it another name (poisonpill2) or something so there is a specific one to each quest.
